newsitem.title: USA: Man arrested in Florida theme-park murders.
newsitem.headline: Man arrested in Florida theme-park murders.

text.p: After a high-speed chase through this Florida city, police arrested a man suspected of murdering a tourist and raping two women near the Universal Studios theme park, police said on Tuesday.
"I don't know why I do the things I do," James Sears Hartsock told reporters after his arrest Monday night.

Hartsock, 25, was charged with raping a tourist and murdering her male companion last week in a hotel across from Universal Studios. Police said Hartsock bludgeoned Richard Banaitis, 26, of Orlando, to death.

He was also charged with raping another woman and kidnapping her from a nearby Orlando shopping mall, then holding her captive for four days, Commander Steve Jones of the Orange County Sheriff's Office said.
Police said Hartsock told the woman he abducted from the Fashion Square mall that he "wanted to see the beach again before I die".
That shifted the search for him to Floridas's coast. He was spotted Monday near Daytona Beach, about 50 miles from Orlando, driving his alleged victim's jeep.
A high-speed chase ended when the jeep blew a tire and a police cruiser rammed it.
